description:
Check a wallet's balances on Base or Ethereum: native ETH, USDC (plus USDT on Ethereum), and any ERC-20 token contracts you list (up to 20), with symbols and decimals applied. Read live from the chain.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

tokens.description: Extra ERC-20 contract addresses to include.

name: wallet_balance
title: Wallet balance
